title: Building Prototypes Dan Gelbart  part 18 of 18  Design
summary: The final part of Dan Gelbart's 18-part Building Prototypes series, focused on mechanical design. It opens with a demonstration of stiffness and covers practical design principles for prototype machines.
why: HN recommends it, and the whole series, for practical mechanical design insight such as how structures achieve stiffness.

quote.text: He starts off with a $10 piece of aluminum that took maybe an hour or two to make
